title.narrative: Activity under preparation e-Governance for the Judicial System in Timor-Leste (e-JUSTL)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste's judicial system plays a critical role in upholding the rule of law, safeguarding rights, and promotingsustainable social and economic development. Despite significant strides since independence, access to justiceremains uneven, particularly among vulnerable populations and in rural areas. Fragmented systems, limitedinfrastructure, and a lack of coordination between agencies hinder judicial effectiveness. Digital transformation ande-governance tools offer an opportunity to modernize judicial services, enhance institutional performance, and restorepublic trust. This action aims to support such a transformation in a comprehensive and inclusive manner, through aunified, secure e-Justice system connecting courts, prosecutors, public defenders, police and civil registries, enablingseamless digital case flows and citizen access. By creating a more responsive, transparent, and connected justiceecosystem, the project will support Timor-Leste¿s national development and human rights objectives.This project is an initiative for digitalisation under the 2021-2027 Multi-annual Indicative Programme (MIP) whichstates: ¿Timor-Leste¿s capacity to take full advantage of the digital revolution in all areas, including e-governance,will be enhanced¿. The project can be also considered in the framework of ¿Good Governance for sustainabledevelopment¿ (priority area 2), that includes e-governance and the use of resources that digital transformation canbring for ¿Green and sustainable economic recovery and development¿ (priority area 1). Although it is not a TeamEurope initiative at this moment in time, there may be potential for it to develop into one during its furtherdevelopment and formulation. The action supports the EU Global Gateway strategy by strengthening digitalgovernance, enhancing rule of law, and promoting democratic values, all while fostering local ownership andsustainable development.Sustainable Development Goal 16 is about promoting peaceful and inclusive societies, providing access to justice forall and building effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels. Equal access to justice is essential forprotecting the rights of individuals, resolving disputes, and ensuring that vulnerable populations like women,children, people with disabilities etc. are not marginalized or mistreated. Lack of access to justice means that conflictsremain unresolved and people cannot obtain protection and redress. Institutions that do not function are prone toarbitrariness and abuse of power, and less capable of delivering public service to everyone.
